summary: Phase 1 Geodetic Engine Feasibility and Proj4 integration
details: Evaluated geodetic engines and established dual-engine architecture: custom 10-param Molodensky-Badekas EPSG:7697 for Egypt 1907 combined with Proj4js for Clenshaw TM/LCC/UTM projections. Verified against native PROJ benchmarks with millimeter precision (<3mm). Authored reports/01_ENGINE_FEASIBILITY.md.
